brief_item: Price-snapshot store: opening and closing numbers for every market originated
what_exists_now: 18,711 market rows (6,237 games x spread / total / moneyline) with the originated value, origination order and, for 14 frozen games, the ledger freeze time and entry hash. Opening and closing: 0 verified of 18,711.
remaining_gap: No official or operator-timestamped opening or closing quote exists in the repository (data/processed/validation_config.json: official_quote_source_available = false). The pinned community closing values are counted per season but deliberately not copied into the store.
what_unblocks_it: A regulated operator's timestamped opening and closing archive, or an official quote feed (decision DB-02 on decisions.html).

brief_item: Verified results feed so backtests and ROI can be computed
what_exists_now: 30 official NFL.com finals transcribed for the forward ledger, each with its official URL (data/forward/official_results.csv); 28 post-pin Week 8-9 finals reconciled against NFL.com (R23). Backtest outcomes come from the pinned nflverse score table.
remaining_gap: ROI cannot be computed: no authenticated executable price exists (gate G1 fails for all 18 candidates). The official score census is a sample, not a full historical census.
what_unblocks_it: An official full-season score census and a timestamped price archive (see T1).

brief_item: Originate the side first; then the total; then the moneyline
what_exists_now: The walk-forward code computes the side first (fair_spread, models.py line 329), then the total (fair_total, line 330), then the moneyline (originated_home_ml / originated_away_ml, lines 331-332). The moneyline probabilities come from the same margin prediction and its prior out-of-fold residuals (models.py lines 318-327). The price-snapshot store records origination_order 1, 2, 3 and forward.html shows the same column order.
remaining_gap: This is a computation and publication sequence, not a timestamped record. The total is modelled from its own features, so the order is not a mathematical dependency. No official origination timestamp exists (see T1).
what_unblocks_it: Nothing further; the sequence is fixed by the store.

brief_item: Publish the fair line, the market line and the difference as separate columns
what_exists_now: Separate columns on forward.html for fair spread, market spread, spread difference, fair total, market total, total difference, fair moneyline and market moneyline (14 frozen games). The fair columns are populated; the market and difference columns are blank.
evidence_paths: forward.html (section 'Fair line, market line and difference'); data/forward/cards.csv
remaining_gap: Market lines exist only as community-mirror values (nflverse, pinned at freeze). Under the verification rule they are blank and flagged UNVERIFIED, so the difference cannot be computed.
what_unblocks_it: An official or operator-timestamped market line for each game.

brief_item: Separate signal from staking on the leaderboard so a lucky staking run cannot mask a bad signal
what_exists_now: competition.html ranks on six signal gates only (G2, G3, G4, G5, G7, G8). Staking and execution (G1 quote provenance, G6 economic reality, stake rule, profit) sit in a separate block that cannot change a rank (rule R8). All 18 candidates stake flat, one unit per bet, the only staking rule in the library. Rank changes are published: PARLAY2_ML moved from 2nd to 15th.
remaining_gap: G4, G5 and G7 are computed on flat-stake profit, so they measure the profit distribution rather than a stake-invariant edge. A stake-invariant signal measure needs authenticated prices.
what_unblocks_it: Authenticated executable prices (T1) and the stake-invariant measure proposed on decisions.html.

brief_item: Track the depth of the replacement (not just the fact of a replacement)
what_exists_now: Depth slots are recorded per club for offense and defense, with the first-listed player, the official practice and game status, and the next-listed rank where the chart shows one. 31 club charts are in the file; Houston is absent (flag F-18). Eight of 32 club charts are verified line by line.
remaining_gap: Depth is not recorded as a full 1st to 4th string for every position on every chart. Only the first and next listed player are kept, so 3rd and 4th string depth is not evidenced. Houston is missing. Club charts are club-published, not NFL.com, and some are labelled unofficial.
what_unblocks_it: Full capture of all 32 charts with every ordered string per position, each verified against its official club page.

brief_item: Correlations computed only from officially sourced numbers; publish n with each value
what_exists_now: correlations.html publishes the n for each relationship and leaves estimates blank in the strict view, because the required official joint outcome and price data are not verified. The research annex and downloadable CSVs carry community-data estimates with n, labelled as research, not official.
evidence_paths: correlations.html (Sample column, blank strict view); data/processed/corr_same_game.csv; data/processed/corr_cross_game.csv (n per row); competition.html (correlation register)
remaining_gap: No official correlation estimate exists. The downloadable CSVs carry values from community data, which the official-only rule does not allow to be presented as official. Flagged for review (F-33).
what_unblocks_it: Officially sourced joint outcome and price data (T1, T2). Until then the annex stays labelled, and no value is presented as official.

brief_item: Demotion gate that sends a live strategy back to paper
what_exists_now: Two layers. (1) pipeline/demotion_gate.py (X7, merged in PR #52): fail-closed ledger rules DG1 look-ahead, DG2 integrity, DG3 sample floor, DG4 stressed ROI, DG5 weekly bootstrap, DG6 CLV, with an optional drawdown rule that stays off until the owner sets a limit; 9 tests. (2) pipeline/demotion_register.py (this session): the strategy-level register with four triggers. D1 signal gate lost, D2 execution gate lost, D3 forward record failed at horizon, D4 pre-registration breach. LIVE is a recorded state (data/governance/live_status.csv), set only by explicit promotion; a trigger that cannot be evaluated counts as a failure; 12 tests. The register covers all 18 candidates: 0 LIVE, 0 demoted.
evidence_paths: pipeline/demotion_gate.py; pipeline/demotion_register.py; data/governance/demotion_register.csv; data/governance/live_status.csv; competition.html (Demotion gate section); tests/test_demotion_gate.py; tests/test_demotion_register.py
remaining_gap: No strategy is LIVE, so the gate has not acted on a real live strategy. D4 cannot be evaluated because the pre-registration check has no complete record, so every candidate fails D4 closed.
what_unblocks_it: A strategy that passes all eight gates and is recorded as LIVE, plus a complete pre-registration record for D4.
